newsitem.title: USA: Knox County, Tenn., adopts $393 million budget.
newsitem.headline: Knox County, Tenn., adopts $393 million budget.

text.p: Tennessee's Knox County Commission approved a $393 million budget for the year that begins July 1, the Knoxville News-Sentinel said Wednesday.
The budget makes few changes from this year's, and leaves property tax rates unchanged at $3.16 per $100 of assessed value, at least initially.

State law requires that the tax rate be lowered to offset the average increase in appraised values. For many property owners, appraisals have risen from 15 percent to 20 precent, so the tax rate could be lowered to between $2.70 and $2.80 per $100 of assessed value.
